@keithamus and @mfreed7, hopefully this is it in terms of the behaviour. Aside from editorial stuff, I've changed:

- Light dismiss (click behaviour) is changed so it correctly closes unrelated auto popovers if a hint is clicked.
- Topmost popover ancestor algorithm should be doing the correct thing now.
- Opening a hint popover within an auto popover now downgrades the popover to hint, and allows it to open.
- Showing a popover during the show/hide of another is no longer allowed.

On that last point, I was pretty heavy-handed, and applied it to all popovers, not just auto/hint. Otherwise, it gets tricky if the popover type changes.

Heads-up that as Chrome rolled this out in M150, we've hit a compat issue. I'm still digging into the details, but it seems that sites (chatgpt.com) are calling `showPopover()` from within the `showPopover()` steps, triggering the recursive call `InvalidState` error. Will update as I learn more.
@mfreed7 any news?

> @mfreed7 any news?

Yes, sorry, I've been OOO. So we reached out to chatgpt.com, and they've fixed their code. (We're still digging into the details.) We're planning to re-enable the full set of `popover=hint` changes by default in M151 (stable in a few weeks). Hopefully just a small speed bump here. If there's still any issue, it looks like it's possibly just one of the new exceptions that gets thrown, for the case mentioned above (`showPopover` within `showPopover`). But for now, we're trying to re-enable everything, including that exception, to see what happens.
